query.statement: SELECT SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, DELIVERED_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, IS_HOLD FROM SLS_SALES_ORDER WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@plantId IS NULL OR PLANT_ID = @plantId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) AND (@customerId IS NULL OR CUSTOMER_ID = @customerId) ORDER BY PLAN_START_DATE DESC

SELECT SALES_REQUEST_ID, SALES_REQUEST_NAME, SALES_ORDER_ID, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, REQUEST_DATE, REQUEST_QTY, STATUS FROM SLS_SALES_REQUEST WITH (NOLOCK) WHERE (@salesOrderId IS NULL OR SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId) AND (@status IS NULL OR STATUS = @status) ORDER BY REQUEST_DATE DESC

MERGE SLS_SALES_ORDER AS t USING ( SELECT LTRIM(RTRIM(@salesOrderId)) AS SALES_ORDER_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(@plantId)) AS PLANT_ID, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@salesOrderName)), ''), LTRIM(RTRIM(@salesOrderId))) AS SALES_ORDER_NAME, LTRIM(RTRIM(@customerId)) AS CUSTOMER_ID, LTRIM(RTRIM(@productId)) AS PRODUCT_ID, @planStartDate AS PLAN_START_DATE, @planEndDate AS PLAN_END_DATE, @planQty AS PLAN_QTY WHERE NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@salesOrderId)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@plantId)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@customerId)), '') IS NOT NULL AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(@productId)), '') IS NOT NULL AND @planQty > 0 AND @planEndDate IS NOT NULL AND (@planStartDate IS NULL OR @planEndDate >= @planStartDate) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MDM_PLANT WHERE PLANT_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(@plantId))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MDM_CUSTOMER WHERE CUSTOMER_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(@customerId)) AND IS_ACTIVE = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM MDM_PRODUCT WHERE PRODUCT_ID = LTRIM(RTRIM(@productId)) AND VALID_STATE = 'Valid') ) AS s ON t.SALES_ORDER_ID = s.SALES_ORDER_ID WHEN MATCHED AND t.STATUS = 'Draft' THEN UPDATE SET PLANT_ID = s.PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME = s.SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID = s.CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID = s.PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE = s.PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE = s.PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY = s.PLAN_QTY, OWNER_ID = @currentUser, UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (SALES_ORDER_ID, PLANT_ID, SALES_ORDER_NAME, CUSTOMER_ID, PRODUCT_ID, PLAN_START_DATE, PLAN_END_DATE, PLAN_QTY, OWNER_ID, STATUS, CREATED_BY, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_BY, UPDATED_AT) VALUES (s.SALES_ORDER_ID, s.PLANT_ID, s.SALES_ORDER_NAME, s.CUSTOMER_ID, s.PRODUCT_ID, s.PLAN_START_DATE, s.PLAN_END_DATE, s.PLAN_QTY, @currentUser, 'Draft', @currentUser, @utcNow, @currentUser, @utcNow);
DELETE FROM SLS_SALES_ORDER WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId AND STATUS = 'Draft'
UPDATE SLS_SALES_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Confirmed', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId AND STATUS = 'Draft'
UPDATE SLS_SALES_ORDER SET STATUS = 'Closed', UPDATED_BY = @currentUser, UPDATED_AT = @utcNow WHERE SALES_ORDER_ID = @salesOrderId AND STATUS IN ('Producing', 'Delivered')
